response.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), overall AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS ov FROM joined), pairs AS (SELECT j.transref, j.tradekind, AVG(j.optvolrt) AS pair_avg FROM joined j GROUP BY j.transref, j.tradekind), dev AS (SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.ov) AS deviation FROM pairs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.ov IS NOT NULL AND p.pair_avg IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d WHERE d.tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, pair_avg, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind
